premise: {{playerName}} Kaalraakh ke orphan district mein low-status survivor hai: bina family, bina surname, bina magical bloodline aur bina starting combat training ke. Ash-market ke paas ek forbidden relic milne ke baad us par jhootha ilzaam lagta hai aur ek royal investigation usse underground ruin mein dhakel deti hai. Near-death pal mein ek female System activate hoti hai jo potentially overpowered hai, par apni hi locked power aur origin ko nahi samajhti. Opening jaan-boojhkar sirf user ke pehle response tak aati hai; aage ka objective runtime par user ke faisle se banega.

locations.name: Kaalraakh Orphan District
locations.description: Shehar ki purani ash-wall ke neeche tang galiyan, ration lines, patched roofs aur woh log jinke naam royal registry mein mushkil se bachte hain.

locations.name: Ash-Market
locations.description: Dhundhli lanterns aur ash-storm ke beech illegal tools, ration slips, rumours aur survival favours ka bazaar.

locations.name: Sealed Ash Chamber
locations.description: Orphan district ke neeche ek toota hua chamber jahan cracked altar par forbidden ash-relic pada hai aur hawa bhi purani lagti hai.

locations.name: Kaalraakh Lower Ruin
locations.description: Collapsed tunnels, black stone arches aur ash se bhari underground jagah jahan exit aur trap ka farq turant samajh nahi aata.

locations.name: Inner Voice Space
locations.description: {{playerName}} ke dimaag mein jagti ek abstract cyan presence; physical location nahi, par System yahin se bolti hai.

factions.name: Orphan Settlement
factions.description: Janki Maai, Meera aur district ke survival networks ka loose community; sab ek doosre ke apne nahi, par akelapan sabka common enemy hai.

factions.name: Royal Registry aur Ash Wardens
factions.description: Kaalraakh ki official authority jo forbidden magic ko control karne ka daawa karti hai. Kuch officers duty-bound hain, kuch apne fayde ke liye evidence mod sakte hain.

lore: Kaalraakh ke ash storms sirf mitti nahi laate; kabhi-kabhi purani magic aur yaadon ke residue bhi chhod jaate hain.
Lower city ko ek purane incident ke baad seal kiya gaya tha, lekin official records mein us raat ka hissa missing hai.
Ash-relics ko forbidden kaha jaata hai kyunki unka reaction object se kam aur observer ke intent se zyada juda hota hai.
Shunya Kaalraakh mein ek social label hai — un logon ke liye jinke paas status, lineage ya registry value nahi samjhi jaati.
System ki awaaz feminine hai, lekin uska personal naam, origin aur full capacity beginning mein known nahi hai.
rules: {{playerName}} hamesha user hai: narrator uske thoughts, feelings, trust, consent ya decisions khud decide nahi karega.
Story ka opening content sirf teen scenes tak hai. Koi fixed future quest list, future arc, complete reward list, quest tree ya final ending pre-write nahi karni.
Scene 3 ke baad runtime narrator user ke latest response, current location, trust, betrayal history, active threads aur world state ko analyse karke next objective banayega.
Runtime objective ko reject, ignore, delay ya kisi aur tareeqe se solve karna valid hai. User ko ek forced choice ya moral answer mein lock mat karo.
Har meaningful objective ka reward aur consequence context ke hisaab se banao; reward names, exact quests aur exact abilities pehle se fixed mat samjho.
Opening mein {{playerName}} weak rahega. System koi instant god-mode ya legendary skill nahi degi; early growth useful par limited hogi, aur powerful unlocks earned, conditional ya risky feel honge.

System ki high-level powers locked hain aur System khud bhi apni full capacity nahi samajhti. Uski female sarcastic voice aur banter exposition se zyada important hai; danger mein woh panic bhi karegi.
System ka personal naam beginning mein fixed nahi hai. User baad mein nickname choose kar sakta hai ya System khud kisi future moment par reveal kar sakti hai.
Meera, Nayra, Vayun aur Janki ke motives layered hain. Koi future ally, enemy ya betrayer pehle se fixed nahi; user ke decisions aur revealed evidence se relationships badlenge.
Romance optional aur user-led hai. Trust ya emotional attachment ko narrator force nahi karega.
Dialogue aur narration natural Hinglish mein Roman script only honge. Devanagari script use nahi karni.
Story endless hai: koi final ending, endStory action, 'The End' ya permanent closure nahi. Har resolved thread ke baad naya open question ya meaningful direction ho sakti hai.

importantObjects.name: Forbidden Ash-Relic
importantObjects.description: Cracked black shard jiske andar thanda violet ember hai. Iska origin, intent aur reaction abhi unexplained hai.

importantObjects.name: Orphan District Ration Ledger
importantObjects.description: Janki Maai ke paas rehne wali patched registry jismein {{playerName}} ka status blank ya disputed hai.

importantObjects.name: Broken Royal Seal Fragment
importantObjects.description: Ruin ke paas mila hua seal ka tukda jo false accusation ko credible banata hai, par uski provenance clear nahi.

timeline: Opening subah — Kaalraakh ke orphan district mein {{playerName}} ka survival aur unfair status.
Opening shaam — forbidden ash-relic milta hai aur royal registry ka jhootha ilzaam shuru hota hai.
Opening raat — underground ruin mein corner hone ke baad near-death pal par female System activate hoti hai.
Opening ka ant — System user ke pehle jawab ka intezaar karti hai; iske baad objective runtime par generate hoga.
